title: Vikrant Rona
desc: When Vikrant Rona sets off to investigate a gruesome murder, a series of tragic deaths leads him to discover a supernatural connection. Subsequently, with varying clues, Vikrant must find the killer.

title: Hebbuli
desc: In order to uncover the truth behind his brother's death, Ram investigates the case but faces several obstacles as he attempts to fight against the corrupt system and protect his family.

title: Pailwaan
desc: A coach on the hunt for a new fighter finds Krishna, an orphan mentored by Sarkar. Krishna evolves into Kichcha, making a name for himself in the boxing ring.

title: Max
desc: Inspector Arjun arrests two men for crashing into the police station. Soon, he desperately rushes to clear his name as the two are found dead.

title: Putnanja
desc: Putnanja, a poor farmer, falls in love with Roja, a city-bred woman. They get married despite opposition from her mother, but differences soon crop up between them.

title: Grahana
desc: Honnarathi, a young Brahmin woman, faces severe community backlash for remaining unmarried. Consequently, her parents abandon her, leaving her to navigate numerous complex challenges alone.

title: Ijjodu
desc: Anand, a journalist, travels to a village to study more about architecture. He meets Channi, a devadasi, and learns details about the secrets of her dark past.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Mathad Mathadu Mallige
desc: A floriculturist and a firm believer of Gandhism, opposes the local politicians to secure his plot of land and the injustice against villagers.

title: Bangarada Manushya
desc: Rajeeva is shocked when he finds out that his brother-in-law has passed away leaving his family in financial trouble. He decides to take on the responsibility of supporting his sister's family.
